The demo for Bail or Jail will be released on Steam at 20:00 on May 12, 2022 (JST).
Please note that the time at which the demo can be downloaded may vary. Thank you for your patience and understanding. 

[hr][/hr]

Regarding the demo ver. release:

The release date of the demo of Bail or Jail has been changed from May 11, 2022 (JST) to May 12, 2022 (JST) or after.
We sincerely apologize to all who have been awaiting the demo, and will announce the release date once it is finalized.

[hr][/hr]

A playable demo of Bail or Jail will be available from May 11, 2022 (JST).
Explore the world of Bail or Jail before its official release! You will be able to check out Delzo Cemetery by participating in online matches!

[u]Features available in the demo:[/u]
[list]
[*] Online matches played in the [b]Delzo Cemetery[/b] map
[*] Playable Monster: [b]Patches[/b]
[*] Playable Humans: [b]Alisa[/b] and [b]Alex[/b]
[/list]

[u]FAQ[/u]
Q1. Will my save data from the demo carry over to the official release?
A1. Save data for the demo will not be carried over.

Q2. Can I join online matches together with my friends?
A2. As only [b]Quick Matches[/b] will be available in the demo, friends may join matches together at random. The official release will allow you to play with your friends using the [b]Friend Match[/b] mode.

Q3. Can I upload footage of my own gameplay using the demo?
A3. Yes. We ask all players who wish to do so to check the terms of service for the platforms they upload to.
Please note that we do not allow the gameplay footage to be used for commercial purposes. Features such as ad monetization or chat donation that are directly provided by the video platform are a specific exception to this rule.

Q4. Can I upload screenshots to my social media accounts?
A4. Yes. However, please avoid excessive editing or using assets in a way that infringes on content ownership. Please also note that we do not allow screenshots to be used for commercial purposes.
We ask all players to check the terms of service for the platforms they upload to.
